episodes.name: The Chaperone
episodes.overview: Kramer supervises Jerry's date with a Miss America contestant; George gets the Yankees to wear cotton; Elaine tries to fill the shoes of a late book editor.

episodes.name: The Big Salad
episodes.overview: Kramer fears a golf dispute has pushed his opponent to murder; Jerry dates a woman whom Newman rejected.

episodes.name: The Pledge Drive
episodes.overview: Elaine mistakes a man for a woman on the phone; George gets baseball's Danny Tartabull to join Jerry at a fund-raiser.

episodes.name: The Chinese Woman
episodes.overview: Jerry makes a blind date; Kramer makes a change to increase his sperm count.

episodes.name: The Couch
episodes.overview: Freedom-of-choice issues disrupt Elaine's new relationship and Kramer's business; George watches a video instead of reading his book-club book.

episodes.name: The Gymnast
episodes.overview: His girl's mom sees George as a bum; Kramer encourages Jerry to make the most of dating a gymnast; 3-D art mesmerizes Mr. Pitt.

episodes.name: The Soup
episodes.overview: Jerry pays dearly for a "free" suit from a comic; Elaine has a beau who's no gentleman; George's way with words ends his relationship with a waitress.

episodes.name: The Mom & Pop Store
episodes.overview: George buys a car thinking it was owned by Jon Voight; Kramer tries to save a mom-and-pop store; Elaine gets her boss into the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

episodes.name: The Secretary
episodes.overview: Clothing problems are a hang-up; George hires a secretary.

episodes.name: The Race
episodes.overview: Jerry dates a woman whose boss has a grudge against him; Elaine dates a Communist whose ideology spreads to George and Kramer.

episodes.name: The Switch
episodes.overview: George suspects that his girlfriend is bulimic; Jerry dates a woman who has a friendlier roommate; Elaine loans out her boss's tennis racket.

episodes.name: The Label Maker
episodes.overview: George objects to his girlfriend's roommate; Super Bowl tickets make the rounds as plans change.

episodes.name: The Scofflaw
episodes.overview: George fails to keep a secret about a friend; Kramer fingers Newman as a scofflaw.

episodes.name: The Highlights of 100 (1)
episodes.overview: The first of a two-part collection of highlights from the first 100 shows includes the characters' ambitions and outside relationships; and George explaining the "show about nothing."

episodes.name: The Highlights of 100 (2)
episodes.overview: The conclusion of a two-part collection of highlights from the first 100 shows includes the characters' concern about their self-images. Also: the evolution of "the contest"; how "marine biologist" George saved a beached whale.

episodes.name: The Beard
episodes.overview: A toupee qualifies George to date Kramer's friend; Elaine tries to change a gay man; Jerry owns up to watching "Melrose Place."

episodes.name: The Kiss Hello
episodes.overview: A physical therapist bothers Jerry, angers George and attracts Kramer. Meanwhile, Kramer promotes friendliness within his building.

episodes.name: The Doorman
episodes.overview: Jerry runs afoul of a doorman; Kramer invents a bra for men. Elaine offends Mr. Pitt's neighbor.

episodes.name: The Jimmy
episodes.overview: A gym member teams with George in business and makes a date with Elaine to see Mel Torme; Jerry suspects his dentist of hanky-panky.

episodes.name: The Doodle
episodes.overview: Jerry's family lives it up at the Plaza for free, thanks to Elaine; the fumigation of Jerry's apartment disables Kramer's taste buds.

episodes.name: The Fusilli Jerry
episodes.overview: Jerry's mechanic "steals" his lovemaking technique; someone's license plates enhance Kramer's image; Mrs. Costanza gets an eye job.

episodes.name: The Diplomat's Club
episodes.overview: A booking agent is overly attentive to Jerry; Pitt puts Elaine in his will; Kramer starts gambling again.

episodes.name: The Face Painter
episodes.overview: Elaine's boyfriend is too zealous a hockey fan; George ventures saying "I love you"; Kramer has an altercation with a chimp.

episodes.name: The Understudy
episodes.overview: Jerry dates Bette Midler's understudy, who gets the call after George injures Bette; Elaine suspects she's being insulted in Korean.
